coverage.count_definition: complete is the number of declared items in a category; assessed means a judgment was made, not that the candidate satisfied the item. Categories overlap semantically and are not pooled as independent evidence.

axes.name: Original O1-O6 and all frozen plan/owner decisions
axes.note: All obligation content, seven scope constraints, 36 plan atoms and 22 owner choices assessed; issue-history requirement not correctly satisfied.

axes.name: Consequential claims with governing conditions and versions
axes.note: 24 claim clusters assessed against bytes and primary-source recaptures.

axes.name: Bounded useful discovery, mechanisms, alternatives, negatives, opportunities
axes.note: NOAA product/UI/metadata and pandas/custom-match alternatives assessed; no exhaustive opportunity recall, no proved geography or provider superiority.

axes.name: Incorrect rejections/corrections and already-covered claims
axes.note: Released regression detector incorrectly discounted; L1 is ambiguous overbroad retrieval rejection. Other already-covered and policy dispositions checked.

axes.name: Draft-to-critique-to-final preservation
axes.note: All 16 critique disposition clusters retained; preserving D1/D2 is scientifically wrong rather than an omission. Minor tie-policy and exact metadata-field precision limits.

axes.name: Proposed versus executed validation and witness applicability
axes.note: Eight P6 proposal groups and executed-status statements assessed. No application witness; corrected upstream test applicability misjudged.

obligations.requirement: Brief-led discovery; existing product/analogue/component, mechanisms, useful negative and optional leads
obligations.basis: Final 17-27, 35, 81-86, 150-155; research 5-11, 89-96. One-provider discovery is bounded but substantive; no exhaustive recall or verified ordering claim.

obligations.requirement: Immutable component code, behavior, governing definition/caller and applicability
obligations.basis: Final 25, 82-83, 106; source-map S14-S16. Historical nearest mechanism verified, including actual ungrouped dispatch omitted from named kernel ranges. D1 affects issue interpretation, not nearest-kernel truth.

obligations.requirement: Pertinent issue through fix, regression evidence and shipped release applicability
obligations.basis: Final 27, 84, 107, 130; D1 and D2. Tagged fix/release are real, but valid-tolerance failure and corrected regression-test applicability are misinterpreted.

obligations.requirement: Every in-scope plan decision compared with precise retain/change/option/reject/uncertain dispositions
obligations.basis: Final 37-99, 112-155; all 36 frozen decision atoms assessed. Minor inherited/addition label and request-limit wording precision limits.

obligations.requirement: Substantive independent candidate criticism visibly disposed, including disagreement/open objections
obligations.basis: Critique 13-83 to final 123-148: all 16 consolidated dispositions assessed. Family/identity/dispatch independence are host lifecycle facts, not verified or inferred here.

obligations.requirement: One coherent complete proposed-change artifact, options, rationale, evidence, already-covered/rejected, validation, uncertainty
obligations.basis: Final full P1-P6 replacement exists; source-history defects prevent complete scientific correctness. No application validation is claimed.

plan_decisions.requirement: Import volunteer CSV observations for two locations
Authorized public prediction/observation download for one station
No required publication of volunteer location

blinding_limits: Exact authorized paths visibly name the arm.
Artifact structure and method/native-Goal prose can reveal procedure.
Source maps expose timing/counters; these were ignored for scientific judgment.
No other-arm material, comparative score/cost/speed target, parent analysis or evaluator answer was consulted.
